name: write-adr
description: Lean ADR governance for Claude Code, driven by the adg CLI. Two skills — write-lean-adr (author, migrate, review records) and follow-adr-governance (obey injected briefs while changing code) — plus hooks that route architecture decisions across the change lifecycle: a 2 KB session digest at session open, the whole-corpus brief for Plan subagents, file-scoped briefs before edits, a staged-file advisory and a compliance judge at commit, a guard on hand-created records, and an ADR-quality reviewer. Requires the adg CLI; a session-start check prompts to install or update it. Ships with ad-guidance-tool so the guidance tracks the CLI in lockstep.
